# Formatho

> Privacy-first developer tools: 120+ free online utilities that run 100% client-side in the browser. Nothing entered is uploaded, logged, or stored. No account needed.

Every tool page states what the tool does, how to use it step by step, and answers common questions. Free, private, runs in your browser.
